tools.name: fetch_dns_over_https_record
tools.description: Queries a DNS-over-HTTPS resolver endpoint supplied by the caller for a given domain and record type, and returns the parsed JSON answer section.

params.name: resolver_url
params.description: Full URL of the DNS-over-HTTPS resolver endpoint

params.name: record_type
params.description: DNS record type such as A, AAAA, MX, TXT

tools.name: download_zone_file_snapshot
tools.description: Downloads a DNS zone file from the given URL and returns the list of record lines it contains, skipping blank lines and comments.

params.name: zone_url
params.description: URL of the zone file to download

params.name: max_records
params.description: Maximum number of record lines to return

tools.name: check_domain_whois_via_api
tools.description: Retrieves WHOIS registration details for a domain from a WHOIS API endpoint provided by the caller and returns the registrar, creation date and expiry date.

params.name: api_url
params.description: Base URL of the WHOIS API service
